prompt.text: Use the supplied image as the exact first frame. One uninterrupted 8-second landscape shot with a locked eye-height camera, no zoom or push. The open sandworm maw at screen-right rises vertically approximately one apparent maw-height through the existing haze; sand spills from its rim and fine dust drifts screen-left. Keep one worm with the same maw design and teeth, no lunge or lateral movement. The man stays in the same position and takes one slow breath: his chest rises and settles once, mouth closed, gaze toward the camera as in the starting frame, one blink at most. No head turn, step or hand gesture. Preserve his face geometry, dark curls, blue eyes, small AL between the brows, vertical G-A-I-B on the chin, paired segmented neck worms and the throat eye-disc. Preserve the dark shirt, cloak, single chain and existing ear hoops on the same ear; do not repair, add or change tattoos, piercings or clothing. Keep the warm diffuse haze, soft near-frontal face illumination and dark maw interior; dust catches only the existing haze light. No new emitter, visible sun, flicker or color wash. No cuts, camera movement, new characters, objects, text or watermarks. Silent output: no speech, singing, music, narration or sound effects.
